senses.definition_en: swarm, pack, rabble, mob

examples.english: So then, Sir, who is to judge the case between these mobs
examples.ref: 1662, Petrus de Conceptione, Soplos en defensa de la pura concepcion de nuestra Senora la Virgen María:
examples.text: Pues, Señor, quien ha de juzgar eſte pleyto entre eſtas dos turbamultas
examples.translation: So then, Sir, who is to judge the case between these mobs

examples.english: "And as for the swarm of asylum seekers, refugees, penitents, or whatever they're called, will there be a cap on their numbers?"
examples.text: -Y para la turbamulta de asilados, refugiados, penitentes, o como se les quiera llamar, ¿habrá número limitado de plazas?
examples.translation: "And as for the swarm of asylum seekers, refugees, penitents, or whatever they're called, will there be a cap on their numbers?"

examples.english: In the audience were comedians, night owls, choristers, prostitutes, fellows in [types of carriages], and a pack of hoodlums and beggars.
examples.ref: 1904, Pío Baroja, La lucha por la vida II:
examples.text: Había un público de cómicos, trasnochadores, coristas, prostitutas, subidos en coches simones, y una turbamulta de golfos y de mendigos.
examples.translation: In the audience were comedians, night owls, choristers, prostitutes, fellows in [types of carriages], and a pack of hoodlums and beggars.

examples.english: A crowd formed at the door of the shop, trying to get their hands on the scarce provisions, and the managers decided to close up.
examples.ref: 2015 August 1, “Muere una persona durante un saqueo a un supermercado en Venezuela”, in El País:
examples.text: La turbamulta se agolpó a las puertas del local para intentar hacerse de las escasas provisiones y los encargados decidieron cerrar.
examples.translation: A crowd formed at the door of the shop, trying to get their hands on the scarce provisions, and the managers decided to close up.

glosses: swarm, pack, rabble, mob
